## 8. Character slots

| Option | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `Config.Slots` | Slots every account gets for free. Tiers, slot packs and Discord roles add on top |
| `Config.MaxSlots` | Hard ceiling — nothing takes a player past it. Identifiers are `charN:` and the columns are sized for two digits, so **keep it under 100** |
| `Config.Prefix` | Prefix on each character identifier (`char1:license:xxxx`). Keep it `"char"` to stay compatible with `esx_multicharacter` characters |
| `Config.CanDelete` | Allow players to delete their own characters |
